structured.approach: I read the DS-05 inputs (task.components, feat.design, feat.stories, org.engineering_stack, org.lessons), the data-science-steps skill, the repository's ci.py, README.md and CLAUDE.md, and the current source. I implemented exactly the minimum design in task.components: CMP-1, a new risk.py; CMP-2, the __init__ export and a minor version step to 0.10.0; CMP-3, the optional risk=None last parameter in explain.py. Each has docstrings stating its rules, boundaries and the no-LLM constraint. I added docs/ap_forecast.md (module overview, signatures, inputs, outputs, edge cases, examples, changelog) and extended README.md. I ran /usr/bin/python3 ci.py twice. Compile, the 3 existing tests and static checks pass. Coverage is 83.3%, below the 90.0 gate, because the new lines are covered only by CMP-4 and CMP-5 tests in tests/, which this step may not write (DS-06 owns unit tests). I did not inflate coverage with workarounds and recorded the gap as a non-blocking open question. I did not commit or push.
tools_used: Bash (/usr/bin/python3 ci.py, git status, git diff, git log)

claims.text: New module src/ap_forecast/risk.py defines HIGH_ABOVE_DAYS = 30, MEDIUM_ABOVE_DAYS = 10 and vendor_risk(history), which returns 'high' above 30, 'medium' above 10, else 'low' using strict > on predict_delay_days, and imports only .predict (not explain).
build_explanation_request now takes risk=None as its last parameter and appends ' Risk level: <risk>.' to the prompt only when risk is not None; load_config and the returned keys are unchanged.
__init__.py exports vendor_risk in __all__ and the package version moves from 0.9.0 to 0.10.0 as a minor step.
predict.py, models.json, ci.py and tests/ were left unchanged, as task.components requires.

CI compiled, ran the 3 existing tests with 0 failures and 0 errors, and reported no static issues, but total coverage was 83.3% against COVERAGE_MIN = 90.0, so passed is false; risk.py is at 56% (lines 21-24 missed) and explain.py at 91% (line 22 missed).
The tests that cover the new lines (CMP-4 tests/test_risk.py and CMP-5 in tests/test_forecast.py) are in tests/, outside the paths this step may change (src/ap_forecast/, docs/, README.md).
No secret, database or new dependency is needed; models.json holds only provider, model and max_tokens.
L-007 is reflected: exactly 30 gives 'medium' and exactly 10 gives 'low', as documented in docs/ap_forecast.md.

open_questions: CQ-DS5-1: CI fails the coverage gate (83.3% against 90.0) until the CMP-4 and CMP-5 tests exist. DS-05 may not write tests/, so the gate can pass only after DS-06. Confirm DS-06 adds those tests before DS-07 commits, or widen DS-05's scope to include tests/.
CQ-DS-2: next version set to 0.10.0 (minor step); Developer to confirm.
CQ-DS-1 (carried): risk tests go in a new tests/test_risk.py (TKQ-2); Developer to confirm.
Carried: TQ-8 and PQ-5 gate the release of STORY-04 (sending the risk label to the provider); TQ-4, PQ-1 and TQ-5 are implemented as their interim answers.
structured.summary: I implemented STORY-03 and STORY-04 in ap_forecast: a new rule-based vendor_risk in risk.py with no LLM path, an additive risk=None parameter on build_explanation_request, the vendor_risk export and version 0.10.0. README.md and a new docs/ap_forecast.md document them. Compile, the 3 existing tests and static checks pass. The coverage gate fails (83.3% against 90%) because the tests for the new lines belong in tests/, which this step may not edit; DS-06 will add them. Nothing is committed. The output is in task.code.md.
